title: Report page contains excessive number of query-generating visuals
rationale: Every visual can generate semantic model queries; crowded pages can slow rendering.
evidence_required: Visual count per page and Performance Analyzer
review_note: Some executive walls/TV layouts intentionally use many visuals.

title: High-cardinality fields used in visuals without clear need
rationale: Rendering many categories or unique values can increase query and visual cost.
review_note: Detail tables/drill-through pages may intentionally show high-cardinality fields.

title: Large model includes columns unused by relationships, measures or report visuals
rationale: Removing unused columns can reduce model size and refresh/query overhead.
review_note: Retain technical/security columns even when hidden from reports.

title: DirectQuery/composite model used without source/query performance safeguards
rationale: DirectQuery performance depends heavily on source design, folding and query patterns.
evidence_required: Storage modes, source type, query patterns
review_note: DirectQuery may be required for latency, size or governance reasons.

title: Performance Analyzer shows consistently slow visual/query execution
rationale: Measured slow queries are stronger evidence than static heuristics and require prioritization.
review_note: Exclude transient network/capacity anomalies before final finding.

title: Auto date/time tables proliferate in a model that should use a shared date dimension
rationale: Multiple hidden date tables can increase model size and fragment time logic.
review_note: Acceptable for very small self-service reports.

title: Model size or refresh duration is disproportionate to business scope
rationale: Oversized models and long refresh times can reduce reliability and user adoption.
evidence_required: Model size, refresh telemetry, data volume
review_note: Benchmarks depend on capacity, mode and business requirements.

title: Visual interaction pattern triggers unnecessary cross-highlighting/filtering
rationale: Unneeded interactions can cause additional queries and confusing UX.
evidence_required: Edit interactions configuration and observed behavior
review_note: Interactions may be required for analytical flow.
